class.name: IfcRevolvedAreaSolidTapered
class.brief_description: IfcRevolvedAreaSolidTapered is defined by revolving a cross section along a circular arc. The cross section may change along the revolving sweep from the shape of the start cross section into the shape of the end cross section.
